name: Dreamina
summary: ByteDance's image and video app, running its Seedream (image) and Seedance (video) models. Free users get 120 credits a day for images and video; what one generation costs depends on model, length and resolution.

image.allowance: 120 credits a day, shared by images and video.
image.arena_note: Which Seedream version free credits use isn't stated.

video.allowance: Shares the 120 daily credits; the cost per clip depends on model, length and resolution.
video.arena_note: Rating of Seedance 2.5 at 720p; free credits may not cover it.

source_note: Dreamina credits FAQ and pricing page, checked 2026-09-29.
